name: The Urban Stalker
text: Master of the hunt. Starts with 8 shells. Efficiency is his hallmark. He walks the concrete jungle with the same grace as the deep forest.

name: The Ascetic
text: Divine protection. Starts with 6 lives. Persistence overcomes all. A seeker of truth who has found that survival is the ultimate meditation.

name: The Arbitrator
text: Law & Order. 20% bonus points. Justice has its rewards. He brings a cold, calculated judgment to the chaos of the valley.
